1) to submit → to submitting / 2) stopped to work → stopped working / 3) to prevent the keys from moving → prevented the keys from moving / 4) on the page was already → on the page were already / 5) to be completed → to complete

items.pre: Two hours before the deadline, I was struggling to finish my news article, since I had been looking forward

items.pre: A paper clip inside the typewriter to prevent the keys from moving, and most of the words
items.post: outdated by then.
items.correct: A paper clip inside the typewriter prevented the keys from moving, and most of the words on the page were already outdated by then.
items.badge: 부분·수량 표현 포함 주어 동사 수일치(2): of 뒤 명사에 수일치 (Chapter 01 POINT 3)

items.pre: It would have been impossible for me
